```
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
   tripLatched: activation runRequest AND NOT flameOK same scan (PUB001/PUB002, S1/S16);
     retention latched; clear only on rising reset with runRequest=FALSE AND flameOK=FALSE (PUB002, S2/S16).
   reset edge: internal R_TRIG; no hold-time effect; invalid reset ignored.
   fuelPermit: runRequest AND flameOK AND NOT tripLatched, computed after trip update, no hold (PUB003/PUB004, S4).
   trimEnable: fuelPermit AND NOT o2Fault, combinational (PUB005/PUB? S8).
   airTrim: if trimEnable then clamp(2.0*(2.0-o2PV), -10.0, 10.0) else 0.0; REAL percent (S7,S10-S12).
   airCommand: if fuelPermit then clamp(baseAir+airTrim, 0.0, 100.0) else 0.0; REAL percent (S5,S6,S13,S14,S17).
   o2Fault: NOT o2Valid OR o2PV<0.0 OR o2PV>21.0, combinational (S9).
   Same-scan trip/reset mutually exclusive due runRequest polarity. Unspecified startup/BMS out of scope.
*)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    runRequest : BOOL;
    flameOK : BOOL;
    o2Valid : BOOL;
    o2PV : REAL;
    baseAir : REAL;
    resetBtn : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fuelPermit : BOOL;
    trimEnable : BOOL;
    airTrim : REAL;
    airCommand : REAL;
    tripLatched : BOOL;
    o2Fault : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    fbResetEdge : R_TRIG;
    tmp_resetRising : BOOL;
    tmp_trim : REAL;
    tmp_cmd : REAL;
END_VAR

fbResetEdge(CLK := resetBtn);
tmp_resetRising := fbResetEdge.Q;

(* trip latch update: same-scan loss-of-flame latch; valid reset edge clears only in safe state *)
IF runRequest AND NOT flameOK THEN
    tripLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF tmp_resetRising AND NOT runRequest AND NOT flameOK THEN
    tripLatched := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* combinational o2 fault and permits *)
o2Fault := (NOT o2Valid) OR (o2PV < 0.0) OR (o2PV > 21.0);
fuelPermit := runRequest AND flameOK AND NOT tripLatched;
trimEnable := fuelPermit AND NOT o2Fault;

(* oxygen trim: raw 2*(2-o2PV), clamp +/-10, force zero when disabled *)
IF trimEnable THEN
    tmp_trim := 2.0 * (2.0 - o2PV);
    IF tmp_trim < -10.0 THEN
        tmp_trim := -10.0;
    ELSIF tmp_trim > 10.0 THEN
        tmp_trim := 10.0;
    END_IF;
    airTrim := tmp_trim;
ELSE
    airTrim := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* air command: sum base and trim, final clamp 0..100, force zero without permit *)
IF fuelPermit THEN
    tmp_cmd := baseAir + airTrim;
    IF tmp_cmd < 0.0 THEN
        tmp_cmd := 0.0;
    ELSIF tmp_cmd > 100.0 THEN
        tmp_cmd := 100.0;
    END_IF;
    airCommand := tmp_cmd;
ELSE
    airCommand := 0.0;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
